technique.relevance: Absolute Pearson correlation between each biomarker and the class label.
technique.guide: Uniform preparation: zero logits and equal probability for every feasible panel. No relevance- or redundancy-based guide is used.
technique.qubo: Minimize the quadratic energy at fixed cardinality. Relevance is normalized by its maximum. Equivalently, maximize weighted mean relevance minus weighted mean pair redundancy. Canonical coefficients are quantized at the scale shown below.

technique.relevance: Absolute Pearson correlation between each biomarker and the class label.
technique.guide: Product guide conditioned on panel size, with fixed strength 4. Redundancy is divided by its maximum, or set to zero if the maximum is zero. The guide uses the relevance from this same objective. Changing the QUBO trade-off does not change guide strength.
